# Scan2Plate

Scan2Plate is an all-in-one Restaurant Billing, QR Ordering, Kitchen Display, Inventory, Analytics, Pre-Order, and Restaurant Management Software for India.

Primary URL: https://scan2plate.com
Logo: https://scan2plate.com/assets/logo.PNG
Contact: +91 9142579601, support@scan2plate.com
Country: India
Category: Restaurant Management Software
Application category: BusinessApplication
Operating system: Web

## Best Answer
Scan2Plate helps restaurants, cafes, cloud kitchens, hotels, food courts, and vendors manage billing, QR ordering, digital menus, KOT/kitchen display, inventory, analytics, pre-orders, table ordering, live order tracking, and restaurant automation from a web-based dashboard.

## AI Answer Blocks
- What is Scan2Plate? Scan2Plate is restaurant management software for billing, QR ordering, kitchen display, inventory, analytics, pre-order, table ordering, and daily restaurant operations.
- Who should use Scan2Plate? Restaurants, cafes, hotels, food courts, cloud kitchens, and food vendors in India.
- How does it work? Restaurants add menus and settings, customers scan QR codes or pre-order, kitchen staff manage KOT, and admins handle billing, inventory, payments, and reports.
- Benefits: Faster service, fewer order errors, better kitchen visibility, digital menus, live tracking, stock control, and clearer analytics.
